# Permissions this app may declare. A manifest permission missing here fails CI.
# One full permission name per line, '#' starts a comment. Say why next to each
# group: the app runs as the system user, so this list is the reviewed answer to
# "what can this app do on the car".

# --- Cameras and the recording/overlay services ---
android.permission.CAMERA
android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE
android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_CAMERA
android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_DATA_SYNC
# Turn-signal tile, digital rearview, dashcam status icon.
android.permission.SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW
# Start the signal service after boot.
android.permission.RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED

# --- Storage: dashcam clips on USB or internal storage, OTA APK in Downloads ---
android.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE
android.permission.WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE

# --- Network: update check and download only ---
android.permission.INTERNET
android.permission.ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE

# --- System-user capabilities (signature|privileged; granted by the platform key) ---
# Vehicle signals (gear, lamps) read through the car service.
android.car.permission.CAR_VENDOR_EXTENSION
# Disables and restores the OEM 360-camera receiver during a camera takeover.
android.permission.CHANGE_COMPONENT_ENABLED_STATE
# Detects whether the OEM 360-camera app is in the foreground.
android.permission.REAL_GET_TASKS
